stemMd: A sector has radius 6 and central angle 60 degrees. What is its area?
explanationMd: The sector is 60/360=one sixth of the circle. Multiply one sixth by π times 6 squared to obtain 6π. Keep area and arc-length formulas separate.

distractorRationale.a: This is the arc length, not area.
distractorRationale.b: This doubles the sector's fraction of the circle.
distractorRationale.e: This halves the correct sector area.
distractorRationale.d: This is the area of the whole circle.
